title: Test files sit outside every CI typecheck: about 150 errors under the full tsconfig
evidence: typecheck:server covers app/ only and no script covers tools/ or test files; `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` reports about 150 errors repo-wide (app/lib/mcp-import.server.test.ts 44, scripts/build-master-html.test.ts 27, app/lib/app-lab-slow.server.test.ts 10, an unused @ts-expect-error at scripts/test-all-locked.test.ts:7). Whether CI should typecheck tests is open
